cover_rule: first 8 lexicographic pairs 0 <= a < b < p with f(a)f(b) != 0; h=(x-a)(x-b)
quadratic_field_rule: u^2=d for the least positive quadratic nonresidue d modulo p
catalog_identity: new deterministic toy catalogue; unrelated to the unsourced 32 covers
scope: exact point counts and polynomial screens only; no Jacobian maps or ECDLP experiment
